title: An internal customer is never offered as a Bill To
custom_preconds:
BLOCKED ON RELEASE: this test checks Bill To on internal and No Charge work orders, which needs Internal Work Orders (SV-11665), not released yet. Do not run it now. It can be tested once SV-11665 is released.

Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, that bills itself.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer I, an internal customer.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, in Estimate, that bills itself.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Expand the Customer card.
  3. Type customer I's name in the Bill To field.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens for customer A.

Step 2:

  • The Customer card shows a "Bill To" field under Authorizer, reading "This customer".

Step 3:

  • Only "[customer A's name] (this customer)" is listed: customer I is not offered.

Words in square brackets in a message stand for the value they name, such as customer B's name exactly as it is saved; every other word of the message must match exactly.
